description: Split a bill with other people, record that someone paid the user back (or the user paid them), remind someone what they owe, or answer a split someone sent. Recording a payment never sends money: Bluu only keeps the books. Fill in exactly ONE of the four. Every detail must come from the user — ask for anything missing; never guess who paid or how to split. An expense for everyone on a trip ("para todos", "for all of us") is a `bill` in the trip's space, split among the trip's people. Nothing is saved until they approve it with `confirm`. After a bill is saved, Bluu returns one link per person: give the user those links to send.

answer_request.description: Answer a split someone else sent the user.

category.description: The category, in the words the user used or one Bluu offered. Never pick one the user did not say: ask. The one exception is a row of a file the user shared: propose one of THEIR categories (`categories` lists them) and show it to them before they say yes. Never one they do not have in Bluu. If Bluu answers with options, offer those.

from_person.description: The person as the user calls them, e.g. "Ana". If Bluu answers with options, ask which one.

proposed_share.description: The share the user thinks is right, as a plain decimal: "38900", "12.50". No symbols or separators. If the user did not say it, and a file they shared with you does not show it, ASK them — never guess or fill it in yourself.

title.description: A distinctive word of the bill title when this person sent several requests.

If Bluu answers with options, offer those.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code: "USD", "COP", "EUR". If the user did not say it, and a file they shared with you does not show it, ASK them — never guess or fill it in yourself.

description.description: What it was: "dinner at Ana's". If the user did not say it, and a file they shared with you does not show it, ASK them — never guess or fill it in yourself.

due_on.description: When the others should pay back, YYYY-MM-DD.

participant.description: self or a participant name; never an identifier.

mode.description: How to split it. If the user did not say it, and a file they shared with you does not show it, ASK them — never guess or fill it in yourself.

my_share.description: The user's own part, when not equal.

amount.description: Their exact amount, as a plain decimal: "38900", "12.50". No symbols or separators. If the user did not say it, and a file they shared with you does not show it, ASK them — never guess or fill it in yourself.

notes.description: Bill notes the user supplied; never returned in output.

participants.description: The OTHER people on the bill (never the user).

name.description: The person as the user calls them, e.g. "Ana". If Bluu answers with options, ask which one.

share.description: Only for mode exact (amount), percent (percent) or shares (shares).

payer.description: "me" if the user paid, else the name of the person who paid. If the user did not say it, and a file they shared with you does not show it, ASK them — never guess or fill it in yourself.

total.description: The whole bill, as a plain decimal: "38900", "12.50". No symbols or separators. If the user did not say it, and a file they shared with you does not show it, ASK them — never guess or fill it in yourself.

nudge.description: Remind someone, through Bluu, what they owe the user.

settle.description: Someone paid the user back, or the user paid someone.

bill.description: The bill title, when the user named one.
